data.title: Skytrain delays due to problem at Asok station
data.description: Skytrain services were suffering delays on the Sukhumvit Line because of a problem at Asok station, the BTS operator said on Monday.

data.title: Call centre gangs turn to new tricks
data.description: Two university students were rescued from call-centre gangs earlier this month after scammers posing as officials manipulated them into transferring large sums of money and cutting themselves off from their families.

data.title: Senate lines up B112m  for Koh Kut military road
data.description: The Senate has coordinated with agencies to secure a 112 million baht budget for a 5km road on Koh Kut in Trat, with the project expected to be completed in 2028.

data.title: Over B161bn spent under co-payment scheme: govt
data.description: Spending under the government's Thais Help Thais Plus 60/40 co-payment scheme has surpassed 161 billion baht, and the Finance Ministry will ask the cabinet tomorrow to consider extending the programme.

data.title: EC refers 36 to Supreme Court over poll collusion
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) will petition the Supreme Court and pursue criminal charges against 36 people over alleged collusion in the Senate election, while dismissing complaints against 135 others.

data.title: Day of reckoning for rival tech schools
data.description: Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-Ok's Uthenthawai Campus and the Pathumwan Institute of Technology (PIT), two of Bangkok's oldest technical institutions, were ordered on Sept 9 to suspend on-site teaching for at least three months.

data.title: Phuket steps up Chabad Patong probe
data.description: Phuket authorities are investigating products sold at Chabad Patong, including labelling, health standards and import legality, as part of a seven-day probe ordered by governor Chotenarin Kerdsom.

data.title: Media explores AI opportunities, risks
data.description: The Thai Journalists Association (TJA) and the Lao Journalists Association (LJA) have reaffirmed their partnership, highlighting both the opportunities and risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in regional reporting.

data.title: Townsend hit by pitch roller
data.description: The Football Association of Thailand has spoken out after Andros Townsend, the 35-year-old former England international forward of PT Prachuap FC, was struck by a pitch roller while warming up with his teammates during half-time in their match against Pattani FC.

data.title: US tariff deal  'taking shape'
data.description: Thailand has secured its desired tariff rate it sought from the United States but one additional condition raised by Washington remains to be finalised, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.

data.title: PM vows no special treatment
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed not to protect anyone suspected of fraud in local government recruitment exams, saying he is awaiting further details before deciding whether further action is needed.

data.title: Most 'unfazed' by Senate case: poll
data.description: More than half of respondents to a Nida Poll survey are not worried that the Election Commission's decision to prosecute 77 people, including 26 sitting senators, over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election will cause political unrest.

data.title: Repair crews battle to reopen Blue Line for Monday rush hours
data.description: Trains running on the Blue Line of Bangkok's fire-damaged Mass Rapid Transit system would resume full services on Monday morning if overnight repairs were complete and guaranteed safe, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said on Sunday.

data.title: Heavy rain forecast for North, Northeast, Central Plains, East, South
data.description: The Meteorological Department forecast is for heavy rain in the lower North, lower Northeast, Central Plains including Greater Bangkok, the East and the South from Monday to Saturday.

data.title: Missing Thai woman found strangled in Taiwan freezer
data.description: A missing 37-year-old Thai woman has ben found dead, strangled, in a suitcase in an office freezer in Taichung city, Taiwan, a week after her reported disappearance. Her Taiwanese boyfriend, 43, has been arrested and charged with her murder.

data.title: MRT train services suspended, fire on track
data.description: MRT services were temporarily suspended at all stations due to a fire on the railway line between Tao Poon and Bang Pho stations on Sunday afternoon.

data.title: Underground fuel pipe leak finally found
data.description: After a long search, officials have located the point of the leak in an underground fuel pipe in Klong Toey district of Bangkok and the city governor has ordered thorough checks for leaks at other, similar installations.

data.title: Poll: Mixed reaction to EC's decision on senate collusion case
data.description: People are split on the resolution of the Election Commission (EC) to submit a shortened list of accused to the Supreme Court for adjudication in the senate collusion scandal, Nida Poll reported on Sunday.

data.title: 12 Thais back, 27 sent home
data.description: SA KAEO: Authorities have received 12 Thais repatriated from Cambodia and sent home 27 Cambodians who had completed legal proceedings in Thailand.

data.title: Accountant held over thefts
data.description: Police have arrested a 27-year-old accountant accused of embezzling nearly 23 million baht from a Bangkok entertainment company to buy virtual gifts for TikTok streamers.

data.title: Border home pilot to launch
data.description: A "Secure Border Housing" pilot project for injured soldiers and vulnerable communities is set to launch in five border provinces, the government says.

data.title: Akanat unveils solar scheme
data.description: Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has unveiled plans to reform Thailand's power structure by expanding household solar rooftop capacity to 10,000MW, allowing households to generate electricity for their own use and sell surplus power back to the grid.

data.title: DRT tightens watch on longest rail tunnel
data.description: The Department of Rail Transport (DRT) has stepped up inspections of the Den Chai–Chiang Rai–Chiang Khong line, now 70.6% complete, as work continues on Thailand's longest rail tunnel.

data.title: Five officers face probe after Chiang Mai gambling raids
data.description: Police are preparing to investigate five Chiang Mai officers for negligence after administrative officials raided two long-running gambling dens in the city centre and detained more than 100 people.

data.title: PP head calls for new charter
data.description: People's Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has marked the 20th anniversary of the Sept 19, 2006 coup by calling for a new constitution, citing more than 21 million votes earlier this year in favour of beginning the process.

data.title: Hundreds of households hit by severe weather
data.description: Flash floods hit communities in several provinces from North to South after heavy and prolonged rain caused rivers to overflow, with hundreds of households affected and authorities stepping up evacuation and disaster-response measures.

data.title: PM to show 'Thai potential' while overseas
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will embark on a three-nation tour to Japan, the United States, and the United Kingdom this week. The trip aims to showcase Thailand's economic potential, boost market confidence and attract foreign investment.

data.title: Mexico eyes areas of cooperation
data.description: Mexico is working with Thailand on marine conservation, sustainable fishing and LGBTQ+ services as the North American country seeks new areas of cooperation, its ambassador says.

data.title: EC's shockwave upsets 'blue camp'
data.description: The Election Commission (EC)'s decision to refer the Senate vote-rigging case, which involves 77 suspects, to the Supreme Court has put 26 serving senators from the so-called "blue camp" -- politicians linked to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party -- at the centre of a legal process that could shift the balance of power in the upper house.

data.title: Dems demand review of frigate plan
data.description: The Democrat Party on Saturday demanded the Defence Ministry revise its 17‑billion‑baht frigate procurement plan, citing potential corruption in the bidding process.

data.title: Chinese man linked to B1bn gambling network arrested in Chon Buri
data.description: A Chinese national wanted in his home country in connection with an illegal online gambling and money-laundering operation with nearly 1 billion baht in circulation has been arrested near Pattaya.

data.title: Flash floods hit Phetchabun as Pasak River overflows
data.description: Flash floods inundated communities in Lom Sak district of Phetchabun province after heavy overnight rain caused the Pasak River to overflow its banks, forcing about 300 households to evacuate on Saturday.

data.title: Two defence volunteers killed in Narathiwat attack
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Two territorial defence volunteers were killed and 16 others injured, six of them seriously, when a six-wheel truck carrying them was hit by a roadside bomb and then came under gunfire in Sukhirin district of Narathiwat on Friday afternoon.
